name: The High Wilderness
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. Places are Classic’s, shown on the Forever maps. Quest text © Blizzard Entertainment.

narrative.details:
Although it is dangerous, Troyas and I have been investigating the ruins that cover the forests of Feralas.

Lately, though, Troyas has been going on his own to the High Wilderness, and I really worry about him. The Gordunni Ogres have taken over that area, and they don't take kindly to anyone that enters their territory.

I was hoping you might be willing to travel to the ruins to the southeast and clear out some of the ogres. Make it a little safer for my Troyas, and I will be extremely grateful.
narrative.objectives: Angelas Moonbreeze wants you to kill 8 Gordunni Warlocks, 8 Gordunni Shaman, and 8 Gordunni Brutes.
narrative.offerRewardText:
I am very grateful you were able to do this for me.

Now, please, don't mention a word to Troyas about this...
narrative.requestItemsText: Be watchful around the Gordunni, adventurer. Their magic seems to wreak havoc on the very land they stand on.
